rows.grounds: compound indicating the limit or conclusion of the stream oblation; accusative object of extent with ācarya
absolutive expressing completion of the prior action before the next begins
compound naming the oblation directed to Vāstu; direct object of samārabhet
prescriptive optative enjoining the commencement of the Vāstu oblation

items.question: At what ritual point should the practitioner commence the Vāstu oblation?
premises: The stream oblation has a defined endpoint.
That endpoint must be reached through performance.
The Vāstu oblation is to be commenced thereafter.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner should begin the Vāstu oblation only after having completed the stream oblation up to its end.
uncertainties: The exact ritual details of dhārāhoma are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having performed the stream oblation up to its conclusion, one should begin the Vāstu oblation.
